The *Dutiyaappasadda-sikkhāpada* ("Being noisy", Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Sekhiya 14) is a training rule from the Vinaya Piṭaka regulating monastic deportment. The text belongs to the *Sekhiya* (rules on etiquette and decorum) section of the Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga and has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

The rule possesses an extensive network of parallels across Buddhist monastic lineages. Within the Pali Canon, it corresponds directly to the rule in the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha (Sk 14), the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga and Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Sk 14), as well as the Bhikkhu and Bhikkhunī Parivāra Sekhiya 14. External parallels are preserved across Sanskrit texts from the Sarvāstivāda, Mahāsāṅghika, and Lokottaravāda traditions, as well as Chinese Vinaya recensions belonging to the Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Mahāsāṅghika, and Dharmaguptaka traditions.
